title: Single section-ring quotient morphism with all chart equations
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $L$ an invertible $X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], and $S=\bigoplus_{m\geq0}\Gamma(X,L^{\otimes m})$ its graded section ring [def-sc-invertible-section-ring]. Let $d>0$, $s\in S_d$, and $U\subseteq X$ an open whose underlying set is the nonvanishing locus of $s$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. There exists $g:U\to\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-pc-proj] such that for every $e>0$, $t\in S_e$, $n\geq0$, and $\xi\in S_{ne}$, on the ambient image $W\subseteq X$ of $g^{-1}(D_+(t))$, the pulled-back scalar $g^\sharp(\xi/t^n)$ satisfies $g^\sharp(\xi/t^n)\cdot(t^n)|_W=\xi|_W$ in $\Gamma(W,L^{\otimes ne})$. No nonvanishing opens are assumed to cover $X$, and no agreement with any other morphism is asserted.

source.place: Tags 01N8 (lemma-converse-construction), local quotient construction and uniqueness; 01NK (lemma-invertible-map-into-proj), differing degrees

proof.text: Apply nonvanishing_section_trivializes to L.tensorPow d, using the proved source IsInvertible.tensorPow instance. Identify the resulting open with U by their underlying sets. Convert unique coefficients on every subopen into the IsFreeGenerator property of s restricted to U, by explicit injectivity and surjectivity arguments.

Apply lem-sc-section-ring-coefficient-hom to obtain rho with the chosen-section numerator equations. Compose rho with U.topIso.inv, and apply the Gamma-Spec adjunction to construct q:U.toScheme -> Spec S_(s). The Mathlib identity GammaSpecIso_inv_GammaSpec_adjunction_homEquiv proves that q induces exactly this ring map.

Set g=q composed with Proj.awayι for the positive homogeneous section s. The chart-transfer theorem applies to the proved generator property, rho equations and verified q global-sections map, and yields every required positive-degree quotient equation.
